instruments.name: Field Emission Scanning Electron Microscope
instruments.specifications: In-lens secondary & backscattered electron detectors, STEM detector, Oxford EDS microanalysis system, 0.02 - 30 kV acceleration.
instruments.facilityLocation: Central Instrumentation Facility, Ground Floor Lab G-04

instruments.name: 500 MHz Multinuclear FT-NMR Spectrometer
instruments.makeModel: Bruker Avance NEO 500 (11.74 Tesla Superconducting Magnet)
instruments.specifications: Direct detection BBO probe, 1H/13C/19F/31P multinuclear capability, variable temperature controller (-40C to +150C).
instruments.facilityLocation: CIF Vibration-Isolated Annex, Basement Lab B-01

instruments.name: High-Resolution Powder X-Ray Diffractometer
instruments.specifications: Pre-aligned Cu-LFF X-ray tube, PIXcel3D detector, Anton Paar non-ambient temperature chamber (-100C to 450C).
instruments.facilityLocation: CIF First Floor Material Characterization Wing, Lab 102

instruments.name: High Resolution LC-MS/MS Orbitrap System
instruments.makeModel: Thermo Fisher Scientific Q Exactive Focus
instruments.specifications: Heated Electrospray Ionization (HESI-II), resolution up to 70,000 FWHM, mass range 50-6000 m/z, Vanquish UHPLC.
instruments.facilityLocation: CIF Clean Room Wing, Second Floor Lab 205

instruments.name: Atomic Force Microscope & Nanomechanical Profiler
instruments.specifications: Nanometer resolution topography, Kelvin Probe Force Microscopy (KPFM), conductive AFM, PeakForce QNM mechanical mapping.
